semantics.points: TargetColoured / TargetMc: the point set is Fin 38 = {0, ..., 37}; chiPrime n ranges over STS on Fin n; ColourLowerBound n r: every type W with [Fintype W], Fintype.card W = n, and an arbitrary [DecidableEq W] instance.
semantics.sqs: IsSQS B := (∀ X ∈ B, X.card = 4) ∧ ∀ T, T.card = 3 → ∃! X, X ∈ B ∧ T ⊆ X.
semantics.sts: IsSTS S := (∀ T ∈ S, T.card = 3) ∧ ∀ P, P.card = 2 → ∃! T, T ∈ S ∧ P ⊆ T.
semantics.derived_design: derivedBlocks B x := (B.filter (x ∈ ·)).image (·.erase x) = {X \ {x} : X ∈ B, x ∈ X} (Tan–Zhou B_x).
semantics.ppc: IsPPC D P := P.Nonempty ∧ P ⊆ D ∧ ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ T′ ∈ P, T ≠ T′ → Disjoint T T′ (a nonempty set of pairwise disjoint blocks of D; Tan–Zhou partial parallel class).
semantics.colouring: IsColouring D C := (∀ P ∈ C, IsPPC D P) ∧ ∀ T ∈ D, ∃! P, P ∈ C ∧ T ∈ P: a partition of D into colour classes, each a PPC; an r-colouring has C.card = r (Tan–Zhou r-block-colouring).
semantics.chi_prime: chiPrime n := sInf {r | ∃ S on Fin n, IsSTS S ∧ ∃ C, IsColouring S C ∧ C.card = r}: Tan–Zhou χ′(n) = min over all STS(n) D of χ′(D).  sInf on ℕ is the least element (Nat.find) of a nonempty set and 0 for the empty set; the set is proved nonempty for n = 37 (sts37_witness).
semantics.roots: root38_coloured : TargetColoured 38 19 (an SQS on Fin 38 whose derived design at every point has a 19-colouring); root37_lower : ColourLowerBound 37 19 (data-independent); root37_chi : chiPrime 37 = 19; root38_mc : TargetMc 38, with IsMcDSQS B := IsSQS B ∧ ∀ x, ∃ C, IsColouring (derivedBlocks B x) C ∧ C.card = chiPrime (38 - 1); unfolded versions of root38_coloured, root37_lower, root37_chi and root38_mc state them with Mathlib notions only.
semantics.witness: mcdsqs38 := blockSet 38 blocks38 = {quad 38 b : b a raw block line}; colouring38 x := classSet 38 (colour38.getD x.val []) = the classes of the raw POINT x section ({tri 38 e : e in raw CLASS j}).  The χ′(37) witness is tripleSet 37 col38_37 with classSet 37 col38_37: the raw POINT 37 section (numbers 0..36) read on Fin 37.
semantics.binding: blocks38 and col38_x are the raw BLOCKS and POINT x sections copied verbatim in raw order by gen_lean.py (raw SHA-256 checked; replay step 2 regenerates Data38.lean byte-identically); data38_range (kernel) shows every number is below 38, so no reduction modulo 38 occurs.  audit_binding.py (replay step 3) independently re-parses the raw file and the Lean literals and checks section-by-section equality.  Since the literals ARE the raw certificate, the Lean theorems are about exactly the raw blocks and the raw POINT x classes; no symmetry of the certificate is used.
semantics.not_hypotheses: The SQS property, every colouring, the STS(37) property and all counts are not hypotheses of any root: they are kernel evaluations (blocks38_sqsCheck, colour38_check_a..d, col38_37_stsCheck, data38_shape, data38_range by decide +kernel) fed to data-independent soundness theorems (isSQS_of_check, colouring_of_check, sts_of_check) and the data-independent counting lemmas (Counts.card_sts_mul, card_ppc_mul_le, sum_card_colouring, colourLowerBound_37, chiPrime_eq_of).
